description: Unified UI foundation exception ledger. Counts represent the approved initial baseline and verify mode fails when matching findings exceed these counts.

exceptions.reason: Global CSS owns theme token wiring and reduced-motion overrides.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When globals.css adds new raw color, important utility, or animation primitives.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move reusable values into theme tokens or shared utilities before widening production usage.

exceptions.reason: Typography role mappings are the approved implementation truth for readable text.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When text roles, sizes, weights, tracking, or color hierarchy change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Update typography contracts and UI README when semantic role governance changes.

exceptions.reason: Terminal and log renderers may own ANSI palettes and escaped inline log spans.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When terminal/log rendering colors are reused outside log surfaces.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Keep terminal palettes inside log helpers or map repeated status colors to shared status tokens.

exceptions.reason: Shared structured log viewer derives level badges and error-row emphasis from terminal-log CSS variables; these are log renderer colors, not product UI status palette colors.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When structured log rendering, terminal-log tokens, or shared log surface ownership changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Keep repeated terminal log level styling inside the shared terminal/log viewer or promote stable variants into theme-owned terminal tokens.

exceptions.reason: PixelBlast liquid mode writes pointer velocity and force into an offscreen canvas texture; the rgba calls encode data channels consumed by the shader and are not visible UI palette colors.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When PixelBlast liquid rendering, pointer texture encoding, or shader inputs change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move reusable canvas/WebGL data-texture helpers into a shared visualization renderer if another component needs the same channel encoding.

exceptions.reason: The P5 sprite compositor normalizes the remote swallow SVG pixels before the canvas applies the active theme color; it is renderer data, not visible UI chrome.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When the support-page P5 bird sprite pipeline or theme-aware coloring changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Extract a shared canvas sprite colorization helper if another production canvas needs the same normalization pass.

exceptions.reason: Cobe preview marker labels expose runtime visibility through custom properties so the anchor-positioned labels can fade with the globe renderer state.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When the agent globe marker visibility system or anchor-positioned labels change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move marker visibility styling into a shared globe visualization helper if another map adopts the same runtime label contract.

exceptions.reason: Sidebar offset reads the runtime header height custom property.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When shell layout variables or sidebar layout contract changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move shell dimensions into a shared shell layout helper if more components need them.

exceptions.reason: Floating table action bar uses sidebar width as a bounded runtime positioning input until the vulnerabilities table shell owns this geometry.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: Next vulnerabilities table/detail or shared data-table floating action cleanup.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move floating action geometry into a shared table/shell helper and remove this exception.

exceptions.reason: Blacklist editor keeps two bounded editor heights for scan-friendly blacklist editing after final convergence.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When blacklist editor layout, density, or editor primitives change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move editor heights to shared editor or settings panel size tokens before adding more local dimensions.

exceptions.reason: Auth retains bounded terminal cursor and login/change-password dialog geometry that is specific to the terminal login shell.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When auth shell, terminal login, or password dialog layout changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated auth dimensions into shared auth shell helpers before reuse.

exceptions.reason: Common bulk dialog geometry moved to shared helpers; remaining smart filter grid and Radix trigger dimensions are bounded runtime/menu geometry.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When common dialog widths or smart filter popover sizing are touched.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote repeated dialog/editor dimensions to shared Dialog or filter primitives.

exceptions.reason: Fingerprint import/edit dialogs retain bounded per-format width and editor-height geometry after shared dialog helper migration.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When fingerprint dialog widths, import forms, or editor fields are modified.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated dialog widths and text area heights into fingerprint dialog primitives before adding new local geometry.

exceptions.reason: Loading, notification drawer, and toast surfaces retain bounded feedback-state dimensions with no current repeated page-local variant.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When feedback components gain shared width tiers or these surfaces are redesigned.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move widths into shared feedback, drawer, or loading primitives before reuse.

exceptions.reason: Asset status skeleton uses the measured compact section-heading line-box height so ContentHandoff does not create a bottom-edge drift when replacing the overview skeleton with resolved content.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When the overview asset status title typography or skeleton handoff geometry changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated overview skeleton line-box geometry into a shared overview skeleton helper or replace with mounted real text structure.

exceptions.reason: Asset status top metric skeleton uses the measured helper-text line-box height so the metric strip matches resolved content during handoff.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When the overview asset status top metrics typography or skeleton handoff geometry changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated overview skeleton line-box geometry into a shared overview skeleton helper or replace with mounted real text structure.

exceptions.reason: Asset status skeleton uses measured sectionTitle line-box heights for type distribution and trend headers so the card bottom remains stable during handoff.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When the overview asset status section typography, trend header, type distribution rows, or skeleton handoff geometry changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated overview skeleton line-box geometry into a shared overview skeleton helper or replace with mounted real text structure.

exceptions.reason: Overview keeps bounded chart, table, and globe geometry that is tied to data visualization density and inspected in route contracts; the exception does not permit color or typography drift.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When overview charts, globe, or table composition changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated chart heights and table widths into overview chart/table helpers before adding new geometry.

exceptions.reason: Route progress bar uses a fixed 3px indicator height.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When route progress visual language changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move progress height into a shared route progress token.

exceptions.reason: Scan history keeps bounded table filter widths, timeline offsets, and runtime drawer dimensions that are specific to dense scan telemetry.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When scan history table, overview layout, or runtime drawer geometry changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move column widths and drawer dimensions into shared table/drawer contracts before widening use.

exceptions.reason: Scan dialogs, workflow editors, scheduled scan grids, and progress surfaces retain bounded dense workflow geometry after action and status badge geometry cleanup.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When scan dialogs, scheduled scan layout, workflow editors, or progress surfaces change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote repeated heights, widths, and grid tracks to scan dialog/table/shared form contracts before adding new local geometry.

exceptions.reason: Screenshot gallery uses viewport-bounded media lightbox dimensions that are intentionally constrained to image inspection.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When screenshot gallery or lightbox layout changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move viewport bounds into shared media/lightbox primitives before reuse.

exceptions.reason: The target website evidence workspace intentionally matches the screenshots gallery's bounded viewport and image geometry for its single-image media preview.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When screenshot gallery lightbox geometry or target website screenshot preview behavior changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Extract the shared gallery and target website media preview geometry into a shared preview primitive before adding another consumer.

exceptions.reason: Search result cards and filters retain bounded result-list, filter, and table column geometry after foundation checks.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When search result cards, filters, pagination, or table tracks change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move result card layout and filter dimensions into shared search components before adding more local dimensions.

exceptions.reason: Compact agent cards keep a 2px segmented metric rail and a radius-derived segment corner so dense runtime bars stay legible inside the compact operational card.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When compact agent card metric bars or compact card density change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move the segmented metric geometry into a shared compact runtime-metric primitive before another surface reuses it.

exceptions.reason: The agent config dialog keeps a bounded narrow width sized to the threshold form so operators can adjust one agent without a wider generic settings panel.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When agent config form fields or dialog density change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move this narrow operational dialog width into a shared agent/settings dialog helper if more agent forms adopt the same width.

exceptions.reason: The install dialog keeps a viewport-bounded shell and a wider command panel so long bootstrap commands and token details remain readable without route-level overflow.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When agent install command presentation, token details, or dialog shell geometry change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote the install dialog width and height bounds into a shared operational command dialog helper if another install flow needs them.

exceptions.reason: Shared Agent layout constants retain the toolbar search width tier and the one-node expansion-cell height used by the settings dashboard.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When Agent toolbar width allocation or expansion-cell alignment changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote repeated dashboard geometry into shared shell or metric layout helpers before another route consumes these constants.

exceptions.reason: Dense agent list rows reserve a fixed metric label rail so CPU, memory, and disk bars stay aligned while operators scan many rows quickly.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When agent list runtime metric rows or dense row rhythm change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move the metric label width into a shared runtime-metric row primitive if more dense operational lists adopt it.

exceptions.reason: The architecture dialog keeps a fixed legend rail beside a flexible canvas/details column so topology context remains readable next to the interactive flow view.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When architecture dialog summary rail, canvas, or role-detail composition change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move the summary-rail grid contract into a shared architecture/graph dialog helper if another topology view adopts the same split.

exceptions.reason: Support page is a bounded expressive surface with bespoke card and preview geometry.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When support page geometry is reused or when support page enters a cleanup batch.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Extract repeated sizes into support-specific shared helpers or standard primitives.

exceptions.reason: Support page skeleton mirrors the locked hero card geometry so the route loading handoff stays aligned with the resolved support surface.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When support page locked-state geometry or the support route skeleton changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move repeated support skeleton geometry into shared support-specific loading helpers or replace with a shared measured primitive.

exceptions.reason: Target add dialog editor, overview CTA accents, and settings editor retain bounded target-route geometry after shared dialog migration.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When target add, overview, or settings layouts change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move target dialog and overview control sizes into shared primitives before adding new local geometry.

exceptions.reason: Tools dialogs and list empty states retain bounded management-surface dimensions after card action cleanup.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When tools config dialogs, wordlist editor, or tool list empty states change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote repeated tool dialog and list dimensions to shared tool primitives before adding more local geometry.

exceptions.reason: The vertical vulnerability detail metadata list uses a fixed definition column so analyst labels and values stay left-aligned across variable vulnerability payloads.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When vulnerability vertical detail metadata alignment, definition labels, or dense detail layout changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote the definition-list grid to a shared detail metadata layout helper if another inspection surface needs the same fixed label/value contract.

exceptions.reason: The vertical vulnerability detail keeps a contract-tested three-panel analyst inspection layout with metadata, evidence, and remediation rails.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When vulnerability vertical detail panel composition, evidence tabs, or remediation rail layout changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move the three-panel inspection grid into a shared vulnerability detail layout helper if the pattern repeats outside this component.

exceptions.reason: The reproduce evidence panel retains a minimum readable code area so copyable curl evidence does not collapse in the tabbed detail surface.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When vulnerability reproduce evidence, code block, tabs, or vertical detail scrolling behavior changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move evidence panel height ownership into a shared code evidence panel helper if more detail tabs require the same readable minimum.

exceptions.reason: Vulnerability tables and detail panes retain bounded dense column, row-height, drawer, and split-detail geometry for analyst scanning.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When vulnerabilities table, detail drawer/dialog, vertical header, or split detail layout changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move column widths, detail grid tracks, and floating bar geometry into shared table/detail contracts before reuse.

exceptions.reason: Overview risk ring and severity rows are interactive chart marks with custom geometry, aria state, and renderer-owned color styling.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When overview risk chart interaction or risk status layout changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move risk chart controls into a shared chart control primitive if this interaction pattern repeats.

exceptions.reason: The support scratch area keeps an accessibility-only skip control that is visually hidden until focus and does not represent an ordinary visible action button.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When support scratch interaction or keyboard navigation is redesigned.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Promote focus-revealed skip controls into a shared accessibility helper if more interactive canvases need the pattern.

exceptions.reason: SidebarRail is a low-level shell hit area with absolute edge geometry and hidden desktop-only behavior owned by the sidebar primitive.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When sidebar collapse, rail hit area, or shell geometry changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move rail behavior into a dedicated SidebarRail primitive contract if the shell exposes more edge controls.

exceptions.reason: The vulnerability vertical resize handle is a drag affordance with pointer capture geometry, not an ordinary command button.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When vulnerability split-pane resizing or handle affordance changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Extract a shared resize handle primitive if another split-pane surface needs the same interaction.

exceptions.reason: The root boot layer owns the initial boot bar animation in critical CSS so motion can start before hydration and remain under the shared reduced-motion guard.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When boot loader visuals, startup motion, or boot ownership changes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move boot loader motion into a shared critical-CSS boot primitive or replace it with a foundation-approved static entry treatment.

exceptions.reason: The shared sidebar gives expanded navigation items a 2px content-only hover translation so pointer movement has immediate spatial feedback without shifting row geometry; the shared 160ms token, collapsed-mode override, and reduced-motion override bound the interaction.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When sidebar navigation density, hover affordance, or motion tokens change.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Keep the translation inside the shared sidebar primitive, or remove the exception when the navigation interaction model returns to fully static hover feedback.

exceptions.reason: Prototype, demo, and visual lab surfaces are excluded from production foundation enforcement.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When excluded styling is imported by production routes.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Move production-ready styling into shared foundation primitives before reuse.

exceptions.reason: Radix primitives expose runtime CSS variables for trigger/content dimensions.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: When a Radix dynamic variable is copied into page-local code.
exceptions.recoveryPath: Keep Radix variables inside UI primitives or wrap them in shared helpers.
